header.name: Export Tags
header.description: Writes each part's layer and pen into its name before a glTF export (for the PYTHA glTF Importer in Blender), and removes them again.

extension.caption: Export tags (tag / untag)
extension.description: First run: append {L<layer>:<layer name> P<pen>} to every part name. Export glTF, then run again to remove the tags.
